name: loom-draft
title: Loom Draft
description: A living woven fabric background: a shuttle of light races the loom laying luminous weft row by row, an iridescent violet→cyan→pink sheen rolls across the finished cloth, and warp threads sway. One canvas + a single rAF loop; committed dark Motion Lab palette; reduced-motion static frame, offscreen-paused, forced-colors fallback.
